architecture.compute: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B; 4GB RAM default; complete SBC, no CM carrier
architecture.power_path: Product USB-C power input -> charger/power-path candidate -> regulated system rail -> Pi 4B USB-C internal cable; screen/AON branches separate. Battery -> power-path candidate. Parts/current margins and exact interconnect not yet closed.
architecture.usb_a: Use one native USB 2.0 Type-A port on Pi 4B for 500mA peripheral budget. Other physical native ports remain present but additional simultaneous peripheral load is not promised.
architecture.usb_c: External charging/input-only receptacle on power subsystem, distinct from internal Pi USB-C inlet; no USB data link through product input.

fpc.connector_dim_evidence: Hirose drawing pp1,5; dimensions include tolerances per drawing
fpc.assembly_configuration: Straight/unfolded tail in bottom-contact connector. Copper exposed on panel-back side; PCB/component face toward that exposed side. Pin 1 must follow back-view drawing; do not mirror from front view. A 180-degree folded tail requires a changed connector/placement review, not stretching this layout.
fpc.insertion_note: Fully insert 0.30mm stiffened tail, close latch, inspect continuity. Do not add a generic FFC as if it were the panel tail.

electrical.buffer: 2 x SN74AHC125PWR, supplied from dedicated switched 3.3V LDO
electrical.extmode: Tie EXTMODE to switched LCD VDD for hardware inversion; NOT MCU 3.3V logic.
electrical.logic_margin: AHC VOL<=0.1V at 50uA at 3V supply test; screen VIL<=0.15V. VOH>=2.9V at 50uA vs VIH>=2.7V. Keep total static output load <=50uA, no strong pullups or LEDs; verify edges and ground drop at FPC.

timing_default.note: Datasheet fEXTCOMIN 1-20Hz, frame 1-20Hz. Maintain COM when Linux stalls; assert DISP low on failure before stopping COM.

electrical.decoupling: Sharp example: VDDA >=0.1uF, VDD >=1uF, DISP-GND 0.1uF. Review DISP edge and sequencing with that capacitor; do not blindly add equivalent capacitance to SPI/COM. Each IC bypass 100nF, LDO input/output >=1uF effective.
electrical.sequencing: DISP low and all signal outputs benign until LCD rails valid. Start COM, clear/update panel, then DISP high. On shutdown blank/clear per Sharp timing, DISP low, isolate buffers, then remove main power. LCD input overshoot must stay within absolute limits.

runtime_budget.calculation: 3.7V * 3.3Ah = 12.21Wh nominal; runtime estimate = usable battery energy / average battery-side power. Neither usable energy nor system load is yet established.
runtime_budget.status: Actual runtime not yet measured. Characterize no-USB light-use and USB-keyboard use separately; include usable energy, shutdown reserve and conversion losses. No two-hour acceptance threshold or derived 6.105W power ceiling.

runtime_policy.value: No fixed minimum duration; report actual results under declared conditions.

battery.dimensions_evidence: Manufacturer product 870 lacks complete pack drawing; no dimensions inferred from photograph or 21700 label.
battery.retention: Nonconductive cradle/strap, no compression or screw contact, isolate heat sources; clearance follows exact pack drawing later.
battery.polarity: Molded +/− marks and measured voltage must agree; never infer from wire color.
battery.candidate_evidence_note: nominal_v=3.6 is the old candidate manufacturer fact, not the user target. Do not overwrite evidence as 3.7V; select/verify an exact matching pack.

power.proof_boundary: Calculation assumes measured boost efficiency >=85%, SYS >=3.5V, 5.1V±2%, auxiliary <=30mA. Not a guaranteed efficiency from a typical curve; do not enable full-load operation unless validated. 10A/50ms charger peak is not a continuous rating. Pack procurement minimum 8A does not upgrade BQ25622 beyond 6A.
power.charger_input_control: BQ25622 external ILIM plus IINDPM, EN_EXTILIM enabled. TUSB320LAI reports Type-C current via I2C. Default/unknown source: no charging, conservative <=100mA input; confirmed 1.5A/3A source: nominal 1.2A/2.6A limits, full tolerance plus always-on draw below advertisement. Hardware must remain safe at boot, MCU reset, CC downshift and register reset; no BC1.2 assumption. Exact setpoint/gating network is PCB implementation work.
power.external_power_balance: Use 5V 3A Type-C source for normal light-use/charge target. At maximum combined output, available input power and 3.5A charger SW current are insufficient for unlimited operation plus charging; charging reduces/stops and battery supplements. Do not promise indefinite peak-load use or operation without battery.
power.current_guard_variant: TPS259531 moved to USB-C input; not in high-current battery path. Its 5.7V clamp is not sufficient LCD 5.5V protection.
power.thermal: At 3.3A*5.1V and 85% boost efficiency, boost losses approach 2.97W before other losses. Validate hot enclosure, copper/thermal vias, BQ BATFET loss and connector/wire heating. Not a thermally validated design.
power.temperature: Two 103AT-2; charger TS_BIAS divider plus independent MCU sensor; target charge enable 5–40C only if exact pack permits. CE pulled inactive until configuration/sensors valid; fault/watchdog fails safe. Open/short tests mandatory.
power.main_disconnect: TPS22990 VBIAS from unswitched 5.1V boost; thermal pad tied VIN, NOT GND. CT slew sized for total load capacitance. Pull ON inactive; main off before boost disable. No reverse-block or short-circuit current-limit claim.
power.charger_application: BQ25622 pins 4 ILIM, 5 TS_BIAS; use 1uH 74437349010. Reference: VBUS 1uF, PMID 10uF + 0.1uF, SYS 20uF, BAT 10uF, REGN 4.7uF, BTST-SW 47nF; effective capacitance/voltage/ESR and SYS <=500uF checked in PCB design. OTG disabled. Layout p75-77 prioritizes PMID high-frequency loop and full-length power lands; use RYK drawing, not a generic equal-pad WQFN.

runtime_budget.status: Sensitivity estimate only for candidate capacity and conservative assumed usable fraction; early SYS cutoff may change it. User 2h baseline unchanged. No USB peripherals for baseline, USB-keyboard/full-500mA runtimes separate. Existing numerical estimate remains tied to the old 3.6V candidate and must be recalculated for the final 3.7V pack; this turn does not certify capacity/runtime.

supervisor.supply: 3V3_AON via TLV75533 from BQ25622 SYS; verify dropout/headroom at lowest SYS
supervisor.bod: Enable appropriate brownout and watchdog for this voltage/clock; no 20MHz claim at 3.3V.
supervisor.gpio_budget: 16 of 18 I/O budget: UPDI 1, power key 1, request/ack/UART TX/RX 4, battery+NTC+SYS ADC 3, charger CE 1, shared charger/CC I2C 2, COM/DISP 2, main EN 1, boost EN 1. Two I/O reserved for input-limit/gating fail-safe implementation; charger status read via I2C. Exact peripheral mux and addresses reviewed in schematic. No old BQ24074 EN1/EN2/CHG allocation.
supervisor.domain_crossing: 4 x SN74LVC1G07, each powered from its sender domain; outputs pulled up only to receiving domain. Never pull Pi GPIO to always-on rail. Measure off-state leakage; no direct push-pull MCU -> unpowered Pi.

shutdown_defaults.qualification: Provisional loaded-voltage defaults for higher-current chain, not measured state of charge. SYS below 3.5V invalidates full-load power proof; shed USB load/request immediate safe shutdown while reserve remains. Controlled shutdown needs sufficient energy for Linux acknowledgement; emergency cut risks data loss. Validate thresholds/hysteresis and revise defaults from prototype, never lower user runtime goal.

supervisor.off_state: Main switch off plus boost EN off; AON low-power sleep, charging/CC remain supervised. No claim of zero battery drain.
